label: Malaysia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Malaysia -- Kuala Lumpur and Penang, plus Kota Kinabalu, Langkawi, Johor Bahru and the Desaru Coast.
intro: Malaysia's coverage in this directory spans the peninsula and Borneo: Kuala Lumpur -- skyline towers near KLCC and business hotels around the Golden Triangle and KL Sentral; Penang, from George Town's UNESCO heritage core to the Batu Ferringhi beach strip; the resort island of Langkawi in the Andaman Sea; Johor Bahru at the southern gateway to Singapore, with the Desaru Coast beach-and-golf strip on Johor's southeast coast; and Kota Kinabalu on the Sabah waterfront in Borneo.
